query: SELECT TOP 3000 source_id,ra,dec,ra_error,dec_error,pmra,pmdec,parallax,ref_epoch,phot_g_mean_mag FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',232.663579354,-10.7213238583,0.25)) AND pmra IS NOT NULL AND pmdec IS NOT NULL AND phot_g_mean_mag < 18
limitations: Unique 3-arcsecond proximity is not independently confirmed identity.
Gaia proper motion is propagated without distance/radial velocity; spacecraft parallax is not corrected.
SIEVE astrometric covariance and false-match ground truth are unavailable.
Split is deterministic SHA-256 partition of Gaia source IDs, not source-population or calibration independence.
